module.purpose: Defines a React email template for delivering a localized email-verification code with application branding and support contact information.
module.summary: This module renders a branded verification message from localized content, recipient data, and a one-time verification code. It composes the shared email shell with structured paragraphs, inline styling, a conditional subject suffix for verification state, and a mailto link for the support team.
module.businessContext: Supports account and email ownership verification in the scheduling product. If rendering fails, users may be unable to complete verification or receive support guidance.
functions: VerifyEmailByCode (~L6-53): Renders localized verification-code email content with branding and support contact.
